reference_phase.scope: Independent generated-fixture preparation only, with its own separately recorded elapsed time and explicit Root-selected deadline up to300 seconds.
reference_phase.hash_checkpoints: Sorted unique positive size values; exact numeric count and copied digests are frozen in the reference proof before any producer run. No unrelated target path/role/digest is read or inherited.
reference_phase.recipe: One continuous periodic00..ff prefix stream. At each distinct declared length use SHA256.copy().hexdigest(). Partial-block continuation uses position modulo the shared1MiB block; never restart at00 at an arbitrary checkpoint.
reference_phase.producer_gate: Partial reference outputs have no complete descriptors and must be refused. Root separately pins and authorizes the complete reference result.

producer_phase.clock: Capture a real monotonic sample at helper entry. Return that original sample ONCE as the actual injected owner start, then return real monotonic samples thereafter. Source origin/work/hard must equal original entry/+295/+300. This is captured-sample adoption for an injected component, not production first-entry/Origin/FFI qualification.
producer_phase.binding: New fictional D:\FictionalRoleAwareLarge paths only; actual source-owned read buffer filled using256B seed plus generic source buffer_write_slice/copy_within doubling. Independent delivered counters derive each request; no subject counter is an oracle and no bulk body is retained.
producer_phase.retention: Keep actual complete issued candidate/terminal bytes and complete call/query/close evidence. Persist bounded artifacts after source returns rather than duplicating bulk/query/journal hex in the JSON proof. Harness metadata/temporary storage is reported separately; RSS remains unknown.
producer_phase.first_result: One exclusive attempt and immutable terminal proof, including timeout/failure/unknown suffix. No repeat merely for favorable timing. No hard callback-free hang guarantee without a separately owned watchdog.
